picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a striking real-world demonstration of AI accelerating therapeutic design.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena, from sand to proteins, in a single deep-learning framework — a significant step toward general-purpose physics AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's AI imaging technique independently confirmed the landmark Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in a Nature publication, validating a cornerstone result in astrophysics.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: A $53M ARPA-H award lets an MIT-led team use generative AI to design safer herbicide alternatives, pairing major federal funding with a concrete public-health and agricultural application.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's 'Workspace Models' give robots a new memory mechanism to recall past observations cheaply, addressing a key bottleneck in robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, anchored by a planned joint lab, signals deepening academia-industry integration in embodied AI and robotics.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration

picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: A $19M state grant lets Texas Tech build an AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor research, reinforcing public investment in AI-driven chip innovation.
